changelog.summary: Adds a bounded trial usage to Sales handoff with exact CRM identity, contact-policy and unsent-draft gates.

title: Trial Account to Reviewed Sales Assist
description: Review one SaaS trial account's actual product use, then prepare a permitted seller assist or an explicit no-contact decision.
setup_prompt: Use Trial Account to Reviewed Sales Assist as a chat-led proposal. Inspect the current Product Adoption Analyst and Sales Follow-up Coordinator Crews, trial/subscription source, product event coverage, exact CRM account mapping, seller fit policy, current contact permission, suppression, prior replies and meetings. Propose reuse or reviewed creation, exact JSON handoff and blocking validator, one manual trial and an owner-reviewed draft or no-contact result. Show the plan before Builder applies it. Selection does not email, update CRM, mark a trial converted, or activate recurrence.

setup_inputs.label: Authorized product account, trial/subscription state and revision
Owner-defined product event rule, window, exclusions and coverage source
Exact product-account to CRM-account and recipient mapping
Seller fit, offer, owner, contact permission, suppression and prior-contact rules
Provider delivery and calendar or CRM meeting source when later outcomes are tracked
Manual-only or reviewed authenticated event and cadence

pulse_focus.label: Trial sales assists
focus_areas: Whether trial observations are sourced and coverage-aware rather than intent scores
Whether Sales reaches only exact permitted recipients without duplicate contact or false outcome claims
review_when: A trial status or usage window changes, contact permission changes, a customer replies, or an approved assist remains open

outputs: Reviewed Product and Sales Crew bindings and source map
Exact-account trial usage observation with status, rule and coverage
CRM-mapped no-contact, needs-review or unsent sales-assist decision
Separate provider delivery and meeting evidence only when authorized and observed
Manual case, owner decision, action ledger and activation choice
